module.name: axm-global-state-rts
module.purpose: Deterministic global-state RTS experiment with local multi-seat browser presentation, bounded world/state systems, and evidence-gated external 3D asset integration.

capabilities.description: Select the evidence-backed workshop runtime LOD tier from the real local RTS camera distance while keeping the far tier on HOLD until a farther handoff distance is proven.

evidence.boundary: automatic tactical/ordinary-RTS selection is grounded by sampled 120 m and 360 m target renders; automatic far handoff remains unproven

callable.notes: Pure selection function. Declaration does not promote the far tier or prove performance.

capabilities.description: Install the evidence-selected workshop tactical/ordinary-RTS variant through an externally supplied exact-hash asset installation callback.

evidence.boundary: deterministic fixture proof exercises the callable selector/install seam; real Universal Creation workshop variants have separate target Chromium render evidence

callable.notes: Requires caller-supplied variant bytes and install callback. It grants no asset acceptance, merge, or CANON authority.

capabilities.description: Global-state RTS simulation and 1-4 seat local browser presentation over canonical game/world state.

evidence.boundary: individual systems have scoped evidence; this does not claim final balance, production multiplayer, target-device performance, or CANON

entrypoints.purpose: serve the local Global State RTS browser shell

tests.scope: deterministic world, simulation, presentation, input and runtime regression suite
evidence-bound workshop LOD selector and hash-checked browser install seam

not_claimed: automatic far-tier handoff before farther-distance evidence exists
target-device FPS or mass-building performance from hosted CI
visual equivalence merely from triangle-band membership
source callable declaration as execution proof in AXM Monolith
merge, CANON, installation, network, or risk-acceptance authority from a callable descriptor
